story_fr: CoStar Group atteint un record de 183 millions de visiteurs uniques mensuels moyens au T2 2024, confirmant la montee en puissance de ses places de marche residentielles.
story_en: CoStar Group reached a record 183 million average monthly unique visitors in Q2 2024, confirming the rise of its residential marketplaces.
quote: CoStar Group Reaches a Record 183 Million Average Monthly Unique Visitors.

story_fr: La monetisation de Homes.com lancee le 12 fevrier 2024 genere pres de 40 M$ de nouvelles reservations nettes en moins de deux mois, le plus fort lancement produit de l'histoire de la societe.
story_en: The Homes.com monetization launched February 12, 2024 generated nearly $40 million in net new bookings in under two months, the strongest product launch in company history.
quote: With less than two months of selling in the first quarter, Homes.com membership subscriptions reached nearly $40 million in net new bookings. This is by far the strongest sales launch of any product in the company's history

story_fr: Homes.com est le site immobilier residentiel a plus forte croissance des Etats-Unis, avec des visiteurs uniques mensuels en hausse de 600% sur un an au T4 2023.
story_en: Homes.com is the fastest-growing residential property site in the US, with average monthly unique visitors up 600% year-over-year in Q4 2023.
quote: We believe Homes.com is the fastest growing residential property site in the United States, with average monthly unique visitors increasing 600% year over year, according to Google Analytics

story_fr: Les activites commerciales d'information et de places de marche affichent 41% de marge beneficiaire au T2 2024, et leurs deux marques milliardaires gardent une croissance a deux chiffres (Apartments.com +18%, CoStar +10%).
story_en: The commercial information and marketplace businesses delivered 41% profit margins in Q2 2024, while their two billion-dollar brands kept double-digit growth (Apartments.com +18%, CoStar +10%).
quote: Our commercial information and marketplace businesses continue to perform and delivered 41% profit margins in the second quarter of 2024

story_fr: Apartments.com et CoStar franchissent chacun 1 Md$ de revenu en rythme annualise, devenant les deux premieres activites du groupe a atteindre ce palier, avec plus de 70 000 proprietes annoncees sur Apartments.com.
story_en: Apartments.com and CoStar each crossed $1 billion in annualized run-rate revenue, the group's first two businesses to reach that milestone, with over 70,000 properties advertising on Apartments.com.
quote: Both Apartments.com and CoStar crossed $250 million of revenue in the first quarter to become our first and second businesses to reach $1 billion in annualized run rate revenue.
